rows.ARS:
Red blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Jacdesa
Exhibition name: Claude Monet ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Jack E. Christensen (United States, before 1992).
Introduced in France by Delbard/Georges Delbard SA in 1992 as 'Claude Monet'.
Introduced in United States by Jackson & Perkins Co. (post 1970) in 1992 as 'Claude Monet'.
rows.Bloom: Red blend, stripes. Mild, fruity, vanilla fragrance. Average diameter 4". Large, double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 35" to 39" (90 to 100cm). Width: 20" to 2' (50 to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Artist Claude Monet was born Claude Oscar Monet in Paris 14 November 1840. He died 5 December 1926 and is buried at Giverny.
